item.title: HackWimbledon front and center
item.description:
Welcome to HackWimbledon. Rebooted. Let’s get the important stuff out of the way. We’re a popup hackspace which meets in real life every couple of weeks and always online on Discord.

If you are interested in, or already do, coding, making, creating, crafting or something akin to that where software and hardware are all part of your projects, or you just want to learn how to get into this Making stuff, this is where you come.
